source_rights.creator: White House Photo Office (individual photographer not named)
source_rights.credit: George H. W. Bush Presidential Library and Museum, official White House photograph P38849-17, 'President George H. W. Bush meets with Saudi Arabian King Fahd in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia', 31 December 1992; public domain (PD-USGov), via Wikimedia Commons. Adapted for Spheres; no endorsement implied.
source_rights.date_precision: Day. The Commons date field gives 1992-12-31, and the White House Digest of 31 December 1992 independently says the President met King Fahd in Riyadh that morning. The photograph is White House roll P38849-17 in the Library's presidential gallery (1989-1993); the roll number itself encodes no day.
source_rights.rights_statement: Retained source statement: official White House photograph P38849-17, identified on its Commons record as a work of the US federal government made in official duties and therefore public domain under 17 USC 105 ({{PD-USGov}}); Commons also applies the Public Domain Mark 1.0. Attribution is not required; the credit is kept for provenance. The copied bytes are the only Commons file revision, unretouched, and byte-identical to the Library's own file as archived on 2020-10-25.
source_rights.age_gap_note: No age gap: the photograph (31 December 1992) lies inside the requested window 1991-01-01 to 1996-01-01, about two years after its start and three years before its exclusive end. Fahd's birth year is given variously as about 1920 to 1923 in general biographical sources (not C01 research; leaders_1990.json leaves it null), so he is roughly 69 to 72 in the photograph and in his late sixties to mid seventies across the window; the prompt asks for one dignified appearance of a man of about seventy with no frailty. The 1 January 1996 delegation decree (C01-45 claim sa_fahd_delegation_19960101) is used only as the window's appearance boundary; reports of a late-1995 stroke are general knowledge and are not depicted. Artistic extensions declared in the prompt: the standing pose, the lower robe hem and the plain black low shoes (feet out of frame in a seated photograph).
source_rights.limitation: Small 600 x 410 scan; Fahd's face is only about 45 px wide, so the prompt asks for a simple, faithful face rather than invented detail. The live Commons 'source' link (bush41library.tamu.edu/audiovisual/photos/37) now redirects to the Library homepage, but its archived capture (20201017203816) lists the file as official White House photograph P38849-17, and the Library's archived file (20201025020135) is byte-identical to the Commons bytes. The individual White House photographer is not named. Date and place are also corroborated by the White House Digest of 31 December 1992.

source_rights.creator: Cherie A. Thurlby (U.S. Department of Defense photographer)
source_rights.credit: Cherie A. Thurlby / U.S. Department of Defense, DoD photo 070117-D-7203T-016, 17 January 2007; public domain U.S. military photograph; Commons crop 'King Abdullah bin Abdul al-Saud January 2007.jpg' via Wikimedia Commons. Adapted for Spheres; no endorsement implied.
source_rights.date_precision: Exact day, from three agreeing sources: the Commons Date field (2007-01-17), the DoD caption (the meeting with Defense Secretary Gates at the king's hunting lodge, Jan. 17, 2007), and the file's embedded metadata. The file has no Exif IFD, but its embedded IPTC-IIM and XMP metadata (ExifTool 9.70) give DateCreated 2007-01-17 (IPTC 20070117), By-line CHERIE A. THURLBY and ObjectName 070117-D-7203T-016, matching the Commons Date field and the DoD caption. Commons shows the same values in the file page's Metadata section.
source_rights.rights_statement: Retained source statement: public domain in the United States as an official U.S. military work (PD-USGov-Military). Commons gives the source as dodmedia.osd.mil DVIC SDAN 070117-D-7203T-016. The current file version (648x848) was uploaded by Commons user Stemoc on 2015-01-23 with the comment 'restoring original crop (can't find original image) with better crop and EXIF data'; it replaced a 776x1032 version uploaded four minutes earlier. The copied bytes are the current version's, unchanged. They carry no Exif IFD, but their embedded IPTC-IIM and XMP metadata give DateCreated 2007-01-17, By-line CHERIE A. THURLBY and ObjectName 070117-D-7203T-016 (the 'EXIF data' of the upload comment). Not a Saudi Press Agency or Royal Court photograph.
source_rights.age_gap_note: From general biographical knowledge (born 1 August 1924; sources vary, some give 1923), not C01 research: he is about 82 in the 17 January 2007 photograph and about 81 to 90 across the window (2005-08-01 to 2015-01-23). The photograph is about 1.5 years after the window starts and about 8 years before it ends. The prompt keeps the photograph's appearance (an upright man in his early eighties with a jet-black moustache and goatee, light-gold rimless glasses and a red-and-white shemagh with a black agal) for the whole window. It asks for no further ageing and no cane, walker or wheelchair, and it says so. The standing body, both hands, the coat and thobe hems and the shoes are artistic extensions of a head-and-shoulders crop, guided by the same-day full-length companion frame.
source_rights.limitation: Head-and-shoulders Commons crop of a DoD frame; the defunct dodmedia.osd.mil source page was not re-checked. Clothing below the shoulders comes from the same-day companion frame, which is not a render input.
